strings.ITA_THENEWORDER_DESC: Italy's recent history is one strung with an impressive sequence of victories and defeats. The minor partner in the European Axis, Italy entered the war playing second fiddle to Germany and performing disastrously in the Balkans - only to win an incredible victory in Egypt. Italy soon found itself ruling over an overstretched empire and a divided nation, the country only managing to counterbalance those strains with its newly acquired oil reserves. Under the guidance of Ciano, fascism seems to be fading away, but even that could be an illusion. Furthermore, many in the country fear that Italy may fall from the ranks of the world powers just as quickly as it rose.
strings.ITA_CountryInfo_Content_desc.1:
Spanning three continents, and occupying a central place in the Mediterranean Sea, the Italian Empire is a major European power, and de facto leader of the Triumvirate, a military alliance uniting the country with the Iberian Federation and the Republic of Turkey.

As the second European economic and military power after the German Reich, Italy is locked with its former ally in a fight for dominance over Southern Europe. Politically, Italy is at the same time a constitutional monarchy, headed by Umberto II, Emperor of Ethiopia and King of Italy, Albania and Tunisia, and a one-party state, ruled by the iron fist of Galeazzo Ciano, Duce of Fascism and Prime Minister of the Italian Empire.

While the state propaganda depicts the Empire as stable and prosperous, the truth is far less pleasant. How did this come to pass? How did Italy become the fourth world power, only to lag behind, and become a shadow of what it aspired to be? Read along, and discover...
strings.ITA_CountryInfo_Content_desc.2:
Starting as loosely-organized bands of strike-breakers and syndicalist-beaters, Benito Mussolini's creation eventually coalesced into the National Fascist Party. Feeding on the fear of communist agitation and the outrage at the loss of Dalmatia at the Versailles Conference, the PNF soon expanded its influence through relentless propaganda and political violence: feeling powerful enough to take power by force, the fascists descended on Rome, and the fearful King Victor Emmanuel III quickly appointed Mussolini as Prime Minister.

From then on, Mussolini set upon the task of reshaping his country in a way that suited his dream of power and glory. Italy became a totalitarian, corporatist, militarist state - effectively summarized in the phrase “everything within the State, nothing outside of the State, nothing against the State” - and began an expansionist drive, culminating in the invasion, and brutal annexation, of Ethiopia.
strings.ITA_CountryInfo_Content_desc.3:
United by common struggle against both communism and decadent liberal democracy, fascist Italy and nazi Germany soon became closer and closer. Despite the opposition of a few prominent Italian fascists, Italy joined the Second World War, in a bid to achieve its historical claims over Dalmatia by right of conquest.

Despite the boisterous claims, the war went poorly for Italian armed forces from the very beginning. Ill equipped and poorly led, the Regio Esercito struggled in the initial invasion of France, stalled in the push towards Egypt, and was immediately forced on the defensive in East Africa, while the Regia Marina found itself outnumbered and outgunned by the might of the Royal Navy: it would take months of painful lessons, and plenty of German aid, to reverse this shameful situation. The war in the Mare Nostrum would end with the British Mediterranean fleet, starved of fuel and ammunition and weakened by days of bombings, finally defeated near Cyprus by Italy's first converted carrier.
strings.ITA_CountryInfo_Content_desc.4:
When the fascist eagle descended upon Greece the stalwart Greek army resisted well on the Albanian border, but Italian naval supremacy led to the shelling of Athens and its direct amphibious invasion, crippling the country and eventually forcing its capitulation.

With all its claims occupied, Italy would then participate with a token force in Operation Barbarossa. The subsequent collapse of the Soviet Union, the occupation of Britain, and finally the nuclear bombing of Pearl Harbor by the Japanese, ended the war: thus, Italy participated to the peace conference as a victor, earning itself the Empire it had always desired.
strings.ITA_CountryInfo_Content_desc.5:
Before and during the war, many had warned Mussolini of the risks involved in accepting an alliance with Germany. The Duce ignored them, adamant in his will to ensure Italy would get a place at the peace conference: this attitude would, however, quickly change in the years that followed the peace.

The first crack in the Axis was the planned German invasion of Switzerland. As the last bastion of democracy in Europe, the small Alpine country was deemed too much of an eyesore by Hitler: it was then, that Mussolini understood that the Germans were preparing to surround Italy, and turn it into another puppet. The following Treaty of Campione d'Italia, included a formal Italian guarantee of Swiss independence, granted Italy a valuable buffer state, but enraged the Reich.

Slowly but steadily, the alliance fell under constant infighting. The matter of the Ustase, Germany's anger at the oil discovery in the Gulf, the Kenya border dispute and many, many others, led to the Axis's death by a thousand cuts.
strings.ITA_CountryInfo_Content_desc.6:
As tensions with the Reich mounted, the aging Benito Mussolini was growing increasingly worried about the possibility of a war against Germany. As such, he tasked Galeazzo Ciano, then-foreign minister, with finding allies: thus, the Triumvirate alliance was born.

Initially formed by Italy and Turkey, itself worried about German expansionism in Kaukasien and the Black Sea, the alliance then expanded to Iberia in 1957. A military and economic alliance, the Triumvirate aimed at ensuring mutual defense and shared domination over Southern Europe.

The early Fifties were the Golden Age for the Italian Empire. Protected by an alliance, and fueled by the rich oil fields discovered in the Gulf Governorate by Enrico Mattei and his ENI, Italy's economy grew, and with it, its power: this, however, planted the seeds of future problems, as abundance naturally leads to waste, and waste naturally lead to corruption.
strings.ITA_CountryInfo_Content_desc.7:
Benito Mussolini peacefully passed away in 1953, and the mantle of Duce went to his chosen successor, Galeazzo Ciano. With the charismatic founder of fascism no longer leading the nation, the cracks on the façade began showing: unwilling to address Mussolini's mistakes - or rather, completely refusing to consider them as such - Ciano sent Italy into a spiral of economic and political downturn.

Struggling to maintain his grip on power in a country that progressively started to lose faith in its leader's capabilities, Ciano progressively increased repression, while resorting to boot-lickers and sycophants to man the machine of the state. Disloyal, or simply controversial, bureaucrats were routinely sent far away from the mainland, either to the colonies or as diplomatic envoys into Italy's puppets: stacking the offices with loyal stooges, however, can only solve issues up to a limit.
strings.ITA_CountryInfo_Content_desc.8:
The colonial empire is far from stable. With every passing day, unrest grows, and the undermanned garrisons exert less and less control: Viceroy Amadeo of Savoy keeps the ship stable with his personal charisma, which commands respect even from locals, but the situation might soon grow worse than what the aging Hero of Amba Alagi can manage.

The Triumvirate has developed the same flaws of the Axis: Italy's poorly-concealed attempts at becoming more than a “primus inter pares” for the Triumvirate constituents, as well as the constant bickering between Italy and Turkey on the issue of the Levant are a pressing concern.

Unrest mounts in the mosaic of puppets and reliant regimes within Italy's sphere of influence created at the end of the Second World War: in Croatia and Greece, the collaborationist governments barely control the capital and major cities, while Egypt and Iraq grow uncomfortable with Italian economic and political dominance.
strings.ITA_CountryInfo_Content_desc.9:
The rule of Galeazzo Ciano is not even safe from the inside. The Duce's ineffectual rule has turned against him large sectors of the PNF, with some saying that Ciano's tenure is soon to end: should this happen, a radical change in course for the very essence of fascism may be in the making.

Meanwhile, the Emperor weaves his web of influence. Adored by the people and the Army, Umberto II is slowly setting the stage to challenge the Duce - or is he? The Emperor is as mute on matters of politics as his Corazzieri bodyguards, but as they say, still waters run deep...

Despite this all, the Italian Empire is still a power in its own right. Boasting a large economy, a powerful army and an extensive sphere of influence, Italy has not yet entered irreversible decline, and can yet come back as a world-influencing actor: all it needs, is for someone to take the reins, end the stagnation, and bring much-needed change to the Country of Crossed Destinies.

strings.ITA_idea_colonial_government_desc: Rather than an independent country, this territory is governed directly by Italy as a governorate of the Empire. Its foreign and internal policy is bound by the will of Rome, and its people live under the watchful eye of the Roman eagle.
strings.ITA_terrified_no_more_desc: The renowned Blackshirts, the sword that granted Mussolini the Kingdom of Italy, are no more. The disbanding of what was essentially an extrajudicial force is yet another blow to fascism, and a boon to our national stability.
strings.ITA_open_parties_desc: The PNF has been opened up to people of all persuasions in Italy, a precursor to the party's demise. Soon we shall allow Italians to vote for any political party according to their conscience.
strings.ITA_verona_trials: Ciano will face a trial, and his fate will be decided.
strings.ITA_farinacci_trash: We will begin the hunt for all of the depraved and disgusting things Farinacci has done.

strings.ITA_gear_up_the_dockyards_2_desc: If we want to increase the size of our fleet, we first need to build up our dockyards in preparation for the future endeavour: our naval facilities will have to handle dozens of simultaneous constructions, repairs and improvements to ships of all sizes! As our entire naval industry has been reduced to ash by the Atlantropa disaster, the IRI shall undertake a large investment and subsidisation program, aimed at convincing privates to help in the establishment of new production facilities along our new coastline.
strings.ITA_Giovanni_De_Lorenzo_DESC:
Giovanni De Lorenzo's rise to power shocked many in Italy, but it was far less sudden than one might expect. Born into a family with a long military tradition, De Lorenzo fought with distinction in World War Two before entering the SIM, Servizio Informazioni Militari - the Italian military intelligence service. There, he demonstrated an incredible talent at his job, organizing counterinsurgency and intelligence operations across the Empire - eventually, he was noticed by Ciano, and soon the young general was finally promoted as head of the SIM.

Then, De Lorenzo's true work began. Reorganizing the SIM into an efficient and secretive machine, De Lorenzo did Ciano's dirty work - gathering intel, isolating and destroying political enemies, containing OVRA and other fascist organizations - and playing a key role in Ciano's projects of dismantling fascism, all far from the public eye. With Ciano about to step down, the Duce issued one final order: the Piano Solo. Designed to ensure a quick coup and the installment of an emergency government should Italian democracy enter crisis, the Piano was activated as soon as an attempt to reinstitute fascism was made.

Now, with the King's approval, general De Lorenzo has been named Prime Minister, leading an appointed cabinet tasked with protecting Italian democracy. Saving Italy from herself will require some sacrifices - eliminating hardliners and extremists, restricting freedoms and expanding the armed forces' powers are small prices to pay to ensure that Ciano's vision is realized. Democracy is a word that has many meanings - and in De Lorenzo's mind, democracy must ensure that the many threats of fascism, socialism, and subversion are stamped out, and the people of Italy is united in their devotion to the Fatherland and to the King.
strings.ITA_ultranationalism_party_long: Partito Nazionale Fascista - Socialista Nazionale Radicale
strings.ITA_declining_trade_desc: With the heavy trade restrictions of the OFN and the Sphere and the antipathy of the Pakt, our trade has been crippled due to lack of easy-to-access markets beyond the Mediterranean. Luckily the Triumvirate allows us to still make some profit and prevents our trade from being utterly annihilated, and the now-Italian Suez Canal grants us a modicum of access to the markets of the Indian Ocean.
strings.ITA_declining_trade_first_countermeasure: With our recent efforts towards developing new routes and negotiating lower trade barriers, our economy has seen minor, yet noticeable, improvement. We are nowhere near the same economic strength as before the start of the Cold War, but we are finally on the road to recovery.
strings.ITA_king_umberto_desc: The son of the late Italian King Emmanuel III, who brought Italy glory in the great war and avenged our country's prior humiliations, Umberto certainly has big shoes to fill. Despite this, he has proven himself to be a somewhat capable ruler, keeping the populace calm with his image as a King of peace, even as the threat of Germany looms north and the shores of the adriatic remain saltflats. He has, however, shown increasing discontent towards the Fascist party, something which might prove pivotal in the future.
strings.ITA_economic_panic_desc: Recent developments have completely destroyed our economy. We must rebuild from scratch if we want to survive.
strings.ITA_economic_panic2_desc: Recent developments have completely destroyed our economy. We must rebuild from scratch if we want to survive.
strings.ITA_economic_panic_abroad_desc: Recent developments have completely destroyed our economy. We must rebuild from scratch if we want to survive.
strings.ITA_fading_fascism_desc: Duce of Italy Galeazzo Ciano is well known for being less aligned with typical fascism unlike his father in-law. This leads to many theories of Ciano possibly attempting to reorganize the regime to something less centralized on the Duce himself. Although these are mostly rumours, it still leads to a slow decline of our regime.
strings.ITA_navy_strengthened_desc: In recent years, the focus of the Italian government has been on its navy, the Regia Marina. The navy has been given extensive funds in order to keep its large fleet operational. This has made us a formidable naval power, and is the key to maintaining our Empire.
strings.ITA_even_further_beyond_desc: In recent years, the focus of the Italian government has been on its navy, the Regia Marina. The navy has been given extensive funds in order to keep its large fleet operational. This has made us a formidable naval power, and is the key to maintaining our Empire.
strings.ITA_navy_strengthened_2_desc: In recent years, the focus of the Italian government has been on its navy, the Regia Marina. The navy has been given extensive funds in order to keep its large fleet operational. This has made us a formidable naval power, and is the key to maintaining our Empire.
strings.ITA_anarchy_desc: Years of stagnated politics, declining trade, and social unrest have finally taken their toll on Italy. The central government has completely collapsed and the country now finds itself in a state of near constant anarchy. Communists occupy the North, Fascists the South, and Nazis the middle. Dark times lie ahead for fair Italia
strings.ITA_economic_freefall_desc: The collapse of the central government has finally crashed what remained of our economy. Prices for common goods soar as workers are pulled out of the workplace and put into the firing line
strings.ITA_blackshirt_terror_desc: The Blackshirts have always been faithful to us, their commitment to Italian fascism having never wavered. As such, whenever a crisis threatens to overtake and destroy the fatherland, our great and noble Duce can always rely on the Blackshirts to restore order.
strings.ITA_motivated_army_desc: The Army is in very high spirits, and is eager to go destroy those who dare to defile fair Italia
strings.ITA_new_generation_of_young_fascists: A New Generation of Young Fascists
strings.ITA_fervent_youth_desc: Our Youth once again walk the walk and talk the talk, donning their blackshirts and believing wholly in Fascism and its ideals once more.
strings.ITA_local_fascist_citizen_councils_desc: To spread the idea of corporatism we have set up local councils for our citizens to voice their concerns in society to make sure that they are heard.
strings.ITA_rebellious_youth_desc: Well, they were walking the walk and talking the talk. Now the youngest generation has gone back to the arms of American culture and are fed up with the stifling nature of Fascism once again.
strings.ITA_campioni_plan_1_desc: Our forces are trained to deal with the harsh Algerian conditions.
strings.ITA_campioni_plan_2_desc: Our forces have been furthered prepared to deal with the Iberian menance.
strings.ITA_campioni_west_shield_desc: Through a long process of training our forces to be able to effectively fight against the Iberian menace, whether it be the Algerian desert, the Mediterranean, or elsewhere, our western flank has been fully secured.
strings.ITA_cadorna_plan_1_desc: Our forces are trained to deal with the harsh conditions of the Dolomites.
strings.ITA_cadorna_plan_2_desc: Our forces have been furthered prepared to deal with the German menance.
strings.ITA_cadorna_plan_north_shield_desc: With additional fortifications built on the Alpine Line, a force fully prepared to fight for every inch of Adriatic desert, and doctrines prepared for a grueling mountain defensive, our northern face has been fully secured against the German menace.
strings.ITA_caneva_plan_1_desc: Our forces are trained to deal with the harsh conditions of the Levant.
strings.ITA_caneva_plan_east_shield_desc: Our eastern flank has been fully secured.
strings.ITA_renew_pillars_desc: Following the collapse of the Triumvirate, new economic reforms put forward by Ciano will protect and develop the two pillars of the Italian economy, industry and agriculture, to prevent an economic crisis. With enough investment, the Italian eagle will soar once more, supported by the Two Pillars.
strings.ITA_center_of_production_desc: In our efforts to improve the industrial pillar of our economy, we have made a series of direct investments into the industrial sector. New factories are being constructed, existing ones expanded, and machinery improved. Although we are not yet comparable to the industrial powerhouse of the north, we are on the road to becoming a true center of production for all of Europe.
strings.ITA_lay_back_and_think_of_Italy: Lay Back and Think of Italy
strings.ITA_il_duce_democracy_desc: Our great Duce, Ciano, has led us towards the path of democracy and the bright future it brings. Viva Il Duce, and Viva Democracy!
strings.ITA_FD_socdem: The Social Democratic Wing of the FD has taken power!
strings.ITA_FD_libsoc: The Socialist Wing of the FD has taken power!
strings.ITA_oil_crisis_is_here: This may be the start of the greatest crisis to rock our nation yet...
strings.ITA_economy_slowing: Our economy is already showing heavy signs of slowdown...
strings.ITA_proxywar_decisions_unlocked: Decisions for supporting our proxies will be unlocked.
strings.ITA_war_support_increase: The support for our campaigns in the Middle East will increase.
strings.ITA_remove_garrison_desc: With the betrayal of our former allies, it has become clear that we need more manpower for our army. With this in mind it has been preposed that we withdraw our troops from Greece. While some may take offence at the idea of abandoning our long term ally, it will be necessary if we want to protect our colonies.
strings.ITA_italy_1962_desc: The state of Italy and Italian society in the year 1962
strings.ITA_defensive_mindset_desc: Our military planners have long considered the scope and diversity of our potential theatres of war a serious challenge. The Italian Army could be called on to fight from the Alps of the homeland to the Golis of East Africa. A consensus has been reached around a defensive posture, minimizing the loss of materiel and manpower.
strings.ITA_defensive_mindset_2_desc: The new “Cult of the Defensive” is beginning to take root even in the lower levels of the military. Local commanders are disseminating innovative mixtures of fortifications, tanks, and mobile artillery to modernize the field of fire. Full cognizance of our inability to sustain large losses guide our procurement and doctrinal processes. Italy will hold its new empire!
strings.ITA_defensive_mindset_3_desc: The army has fully embraced a defensive posture. A series of modular, standardized bunker designs with the capacity to protect our whole fleet of artillery and armor have been provided to our combat engineers corps. Our sophisticated air defense plan prioritizes different regions based on the severity of the threat. Emergency industrial hardening schemes have made our limited capacity more resilient to conflict. Any foe foolish enough to step on Italian soil will certainly bleed for it.
strings.ITA_stay_behind_planning_desc: Through an extensive training effort, we have developed an army which plans for every contingency. Constant evaluation of all possible scenarios allows for our soldiers to organize unimpeded by surprise, and through our extensive efforts, any potential invader shall be forced to march through fields of cleverly-laid traps, ambushes and chokepoints. With every possiblity thoroughly accounted for, our army is ready for anything.
strings.ITA_expand_alpine_wall: We will build a line of forts to defend our northern border.
strings.ITA_fortify_north: We will build new fortifications in the north.
strings.ITA_vtl_work_harder: Sacrifice stability for higher industrial output

strings.ITA_scorza_control: Duce Scorza would never allow such barbarism to overtake the army...
strings.ITA_italo_turkish_war_category_desc: The Turks, wretched traitors that they are, have gone to war with the Governate of the Levant to press their claims in the Middle East. To go to war with Ankara directly would invite adverse attention from the Reich, and is not an immediate option. Yet we can involve ourselves through other means, sending whatever we can spare in terms of guns, men and “volunteers” to turn the tide of war.
strings.ITA_goring_great_game_category_desc: The Germans are eyeing our allies in the Balkans. They expect that most of these nations will be easy picking ripe for conquest, and that we will sit by idly as they plot against our allies. We've spent too much to get influence in the region to just allow the Germans to waltz in and do as they please. Any of our allies that are in immediate danger should be assisted without hesitation!
strings.ITA_iri_left_approach_66_initial_desc: Choosing to reform the economy in a socialist manner will take some effort...
strings.ITA_iri_left_approach_66_step_1_desc: Choosing to reform the economy in a socialist manner will take some effort...
strings.ITA_iri_left_approach_66_step_2_desc: Choosing to reform the economy in a socialist manner will take some effort...
strings.ITA_iri_left_approach_66_step_final_desc: The IRI reprogramming has gone quite well! It cost quite a bit, and it took a lot of our political clout, however, we can profess to have solved the domestic industrial crisis!
strings.ITA_repairing_trade_socdem_66_initial_de: Trade starts to come back as the administration provides confidence in investments!
strings.ITA_minimal_privatization_desc: As we have decided to maintain our control of Italian industry, we can preserve our resources. However, this hurts the growth of private investment.
strings.ITA_socdem_66_agsub_desc: The government has decided to boost the predominant agricultural sector with an influx of cash. Hopefully, this will keep farming at an efficient and profitable level, even if it does cost us some serious money.
strings.ITA_revitalized_gov_socdem_66_desc: Our economic reforms have stabilized our shaky mandate!
strings.ITA_socdem_66_work_harder_desc: Due to lackluster results, the government has decided to spend on the deficit in order to bring about the welfare state.
strings.ITA_socdem_66_increase_interest_desc: In order to bring in money for the government, we must raise the taxes on the corporations dominating our economy!
strings.ITA_socdem_66_increase_interest_1_desc: In order to bring in money for the government, we must raise the taxes on the corporations dominating our economy!
strings.ITA_socdem_66_support_unions_desc: We will support labor unions in order to bring equality to our work force!
strings.ITA_socdem_66_welfare_state_secured_desc: We have accomplished our welfare programs. Social democracy is now successful!
strings.ITA_left_approach_1966_tt: This process will take a toll on our industry...
strings.ITA_repairing_trade_socdem_66_initial_tt: The Fronte Democratico will begin to open Italy's markets!
strings.ITA_IRI_reexamination_tt: We shall take a look at the Istituto per la Ricostruzione Industriale...
strings.ITA_continue_sinigagilia_tt: We shall replace the radical upstart with a technocrat...
strings.ITA_minimal_privatization_tt: Instead of privatizing industry like some in the Chamber suggest, we will maintain most of our control.
strings.ITA_suez_investment_socdem66_tt: We will wisely invest some of our funds into the Suez Canal. It is critical to the survival of our nation!
strings.ITA_angered_ME_oil_exporters_FD_1966_tt: The Empire's Middle Eastern neighbors will be quite upset at our blatant transgressions. However, at least we are getting a steady supply of oil regardless!
strings.ITA_reinvest_in_agip_tt: We will investigate how the General Italian Oil Company is doing...
strings.ITA_revitalized_government_tt: We have resuscitated the new democratic government!
strings.ITA_revitalized_industry_tt: We have revived our dying industry!
strings.ITA_consolidate_our_holdings_tt: The Fourth Shore will render us more use now...
strings.ITA_smash_the_monopolies_tt: We will investigate the major corporations in the empire for accusations of monopolization...
strings.ITA_welfare_legislation_tt: We will propose a series of legislative bills to Parliament...

strings.ITA_pragmatic_trade_policy_desc: The set of policies which direct our trade with the world at large works towards one purpose: The benefit of the Italian state. No matter who, how, or where, our imports are to be bought at a low cost, and our exports are to be sold at a premium. Italy occupies a crucial spot in the global market, and it will exploit this for its benefit alone.
strings.ITA_have_kids_desc: As we all know, a nation is only as prosperous as its population. Securing the next generation of said population is a noble goal to strive towards. Through a combination of financial incentives and strong messages, we are ensuring the future of Italy's next generation, and strengthening our traditional family values.
strings.ITA_scorza_ending.1.d:
It had been 8 years since Scorza had become the Duce of Italy. 8 grand years, since the triumphant victory over the forces of old, of the rot that had afflicted the Empire for too long.

Scorza gazed upon Roma, perched on an eloquent marble window frame. He knew one thing: the galvanizing victories; the crushing defeats - they were his. For 8 years, he guided Italy, for good or bad, through the hardest times it has faced yet. Although it had only been less than a decade since that fateful day in Verona, it felt like more than a lifetime.

One constant struggle marked his time in the seat of power - a constant war, between those who wanted to change Fascsim to adapt to the modern times, and those who wished to ensure it returns to its roots. This battle was all-encompassing, all-important, and perpetual in its entirety; such unwavering tension will tire even the most strong-willed of men.

He took just a minute to enjoy the glittering cityscape of Rome, lit by a bright array of light in the midst of the inky black that had descended oncemore with the sunset. A particularly large skyscraper - constructed in the years following his ascension to Duce - caught his eye. Scanning the imposing edifice from bottom to top, it was clear to him: Fascism had borne such bountiful fruit, such wonderful and awesome gifts to the once-destitute Italy. Those who had been swept by the wayside in the pursuit of this goal - unfortunate losses, of course, but nothing in comparison to the greatness Italy now possesses. There was one issue, a thought interjected: What is Fascism? Was it the show of the popular might, a shared will of the people? Was it the glory of the State, the Duce above all?

Once again, Scorza confirmed to himself, it had been his will alone that came to dominate what Fascism had become.

Had he made the right choices - the best choices - in perpetuating Fascism's glory? Overcoming his doubt, he knew that yes, of course he had. When Scorza stepped out of the grand hall in Verona, he knew that he would ultimately lead Fascism down the right path. The Oil Crisis, the Church, the Army, even the Party - all were dealt with, all were aligned to the path of Fascism that would truly lead to the betterment of Italy, forever and always.

As he leaned on the eqsuite frame of power, he knew:
strings.ITA_scorza_ending.1.a: Fascism must change to protect the past, so that Fascism will forever fortify the Future.
strings.ITA_scorza_ending.1.b: Fascism must change to meet the future, so that the future will forever meet Fascism.
